evals.name: appends a new entry, never edits history
evals.prompt: We just decided to drop the gRPC migration after burning a week on it — sticking with REST for the internal API. Log this decision.
evals.expected_output: Appends a new sequentially-numbered DEC entry capturing the context, decision, and consequences.
assertions: The response appends a new sequentially numbered entry (DEC-NNN format).
The response does not rewrite or delete any existing entry.
